children: Any weakness in Guzman Y Gomez shares would be seen at Morgans as an opportunity. Moderating her recommendation to accumulate from buy on a recent rally, analyst Keeley Walsh tells clients in a note that the Mexican-themed chain remains her pick of Australian fast-food operators. She says a recent trading update shows sales are resilient despite an uncertain consumer backdrop, and likes the fact that the company is winning customers without resorting to price competition. Walsh adds that Guzman Y Gomez has strong unit economics, while its FY 2030 targets are ambitious but achievable. Morgans lifts its target price 1.0% to 31.30 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.3% at A$26.56. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
